items.title_en: 'Crush this lady': how eBay harassment campaign led to $56M payout
items.title_zh: “打压这位女士”：eBay 骚扰行动如何引发 5600 万美元赔偿
items.summary_en: A high-profile harassment case where coordinated abuse online led to a multi-million-dollar payout, underscoring platform liability and the need for robust anti-abuse measures. It shows how targeted campaigns can translate into serious legal consequences.
items.summary_zh: 一起高度关注的网络骚扰案，持续攻击导致当事人获得巨额赔偿，凸显平台治理与反滥用机制的重要性。文章分析了骚扰活动的法律后果以及对商业平台的风险。

items.title_en: EU Age Verification Project Mandates Hardware-Bound Attestation
items.title_zh: 欧盟年龄验证计划强制硬件绑定的认证
items.summary_en: EU's age-verification initiative would require hardware-bound attestation to verify user age, raising privacy, accessibility, and security questions. The move could push TPM- or secure enclave-based checks into compliance workflows and affect device manufacturers.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟的年龄验证计划可能要求硬件绑定的证明来核验年龄，引发隐私、可访问性和安全性方面的讨论。此举或将把信任链和设备特征纳入合规流程，并影响厂商设计。

items.title_en: Europe EV Sales BEVs Jump 50% & Reach 26% Market Share
items.title_zh: 欧洲电动汽车销量：BEV 增长 50% 占比 26%
items.summary_en: Europe saw BEV sales up sharply, capturing around a quarter of the market as BEVs rise 50%. The growth signals shifting consumer demand and policy alignment, with implications for grid planning and automotive supply.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲电动车销量显著上升，BEV 市场份额达到约26%，同比增长约50%。这显示消费者需求、政策取向与电动车供应链均在加速转型，对电网与汽车产业有深远影响。

items.title_en: My personal AI benchmark: "Generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw."
items.title_zh: 我的个人 AI 基准测试：生成一只哈布斯堡下巴的青蛙的 SVG
items.summary_en: A whimsical prompt-based benchmark that tests an AI's ability to generate precise vector graphics from a quirky instruction. It highlights strengths and limits in prompt engineering, rendering quality, and control over SVG output.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个基于提示的有趣基准，测试AI是否能从一个怪异的指令中直接生成矢量图 SVG。分析显示模型在精确性、可控性和输出格式方面的优劣，凸显提示工程的作用。

items.title_en: AI Mania: From Tulips to Tokens
items.title_zh: AI 疯狂：从郁金香到代币
items.summary_en: A meditation on hype cycles in AI, tracing parallels from past speculative manias to today’s tokenized tools, and urging skepticism about hype while acknowledging practical toolchains value.
items.summary_zh: 反思 AI 热潮的周期性，从历史上的投机狂热到如今的工具化 AI，提醒读者在追逐新工具时保持健康的怀疑态度，同时肯定务实的工具链价值。

items.title_en: How the words we teach English language learners changed
items.title_zh: 我们教给英语学习者的单词如何改变
items.summary_en: An exploration of how teaching essential words to English learners has evolved, highlighting shifts in frequency and utility. The data-driven piece shows how vocabulary priorities change with pedagogy, technology, and global needs.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了对英语学习者教授的“核心单词”体系如何随时间演变，强调词汇的频率与实用性变化。通过数据驱动的呈现，展示了在教学、技术与全球需求推动下，词汇教学的优先级如何调整。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kakehashi – Experimental userspace to run macOS binaries on Linux ARM
items.title_zh: Show HN: Kakehashi — 在 Linux ARM 上运行 macOS 二进制的实验性用户空间
items.summary_en: An experimental userspace named Kakehashi aims to run macOS binaries on Linux ARM. It demonstrates early cross-OS binary compatibility efforts, showing how researchers pursue macOS-on-Linux portability, though the project remains unstable and not production-ready.
items.summary_zh: Kakehashi 是一个实验性用户空间，目标是在 Linux ARM 上直接运行 macOS 二进制。该项目展示了跨操作系统二进制兼容性的早期尝试，尽管处于不稳定、非生产就绪状态。

items.title_en: Show HN: NixOS-DGX-Spark – Nix and NixOS on the DGX Spark
items.title_zh: Show HN: NixOS-DGX-Spark — 在 DGX Spark 上实现 Nix/NixOS
items.summary_en: A project porting Nix/NixOS onto Nvidia DGX Spark shows how reproducible environments can be built for AI workloads on a GPU cluster. It demonstrates declarative configuration managing complex GPU drivers and software stacks across nodes, reducing drift.
items.summary_zh: 一个在 DGX Spark 上运行 Nix/NixOS 的实验性工作，旨在为 GPU 集群上的 AI 工作负载提供可重复的环境。它展示了如何通过声明式、可重复的配置来统一管理复杂的 GPU 驱动和软件栈，并在多节点间保持一致性。

items.title_en: Wikimedia Foundation refuses union recognition, hires union-busting law firm
items.title_zh: 维基媒体基金会拒绝承认工会并雇用打压工会的律师事务所
items.summary_en: Wikimedia Foundation declined to recognize a union and hired a law firm known for anti-union work. The decision intensifies worker organizing questions at Wikimedia and may affect governance and labor relations.
items.summary_zh: 维基媒体基金会拒绝承认工会，并雇佣了以反工会著称的律师事务所。此举放大了在维基媒体内部的工会组织问题，并可能影响治理结构与劳资关系。

items.title_en: Californians' data deletion requests, DROP, become enforceable Aug. 1
items.title_zh: 加州数据删除请求（DROP）将于8月1日生效
items.summary_en: California's consumer data deletion requests become legally enforceable, requiring firms to honor DELETE requests and purge data where applicable. It raises operational challenges for data brokers, retention policies, and cross-border data flows.
items.summary_zh: 加州的数据删除请求（DROP）将于8月1日开始强制执行，企业需遵循用户删除数据的权利。此举对数据经纪、数据保留策略与跨境数据流动提出了新的合规挑战。

items.title_en: A Rant About “Technology” (2005)
items.title_zh: 对“技术”的抨击（2005）
items.summary_en: Ursula K. Le Guin writes a sharp critique of technology and its social impact, urging people to consider what we gain and lose with progress. The piece challenges techno-optimism and emphasizes human values over technological fetish.
items.summary_zh: 乌尔斯拉·K·勒古恩对科技及其社会影响提出尖锐批评，敦促人们反思以进步之名所带来的得失。她质疑科技乐观主义，强调人文价值应置于技术之上。

items.title_en: Show HN: Make your Framework 12 sound like a creaky door
items.title_zh: Show HN: 让 Framework 12 发出嘎吱作响的门声
items.summary_en: A playful Show HN post about a tiny project that makes a framework's runtime or output audible as a creaky door sound, using audio as a status signal. It riffs on developer UX and demonstrates how small feedback loops can feel surprisingly expressive.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个极具趣味性的 Show HN 项目：让 Framework 12 产生嘎吱作响的门声，用声音作为状态信号。通过这个小实验，展示了以声音提升开发者体验的可能性。

items.title_en: Meshdiff – visually compare two STL versions in the browser, client-side
items.title_zh: Meshdiff：在浏览器端可视化对比两个 STL 版本
items.summary_en: Meshdiff lets you visually diff two STL mesh versions directly in the browser, without servers. It’s a handy tool for 3D designers to spot geometric changes between revisions and review modifications quickly.
items.summary_zh: Meshdiff 允许在浏览器中直观对比两个 STL 网格版本，无需服务器。对 3D 设计师来说，能快速发现修订中的几何变化并回顾修改。

items.title_en: Twenty Years of RISC OS Open
items.title_zh: RISC OS Open 二十周年
items.summary_en: Two decades after RISC OS Open began, the project has grown through community contributions, new ports, and ongoing maintenance of a historic operating system. The anniversary underscores how open governance can sustain niche platforms on modern hardware and keep a loyal user base engaged.
items.summary_zh: 自 RISC OS Open 推出以来已走过二十年，社区贡献、新移植与持续维护让这套历史操作系统在现代硬件上仍活跃。周年庆凸显开源治理如何支撑小众平台长期发展与社区活跃度。

items.title_en: Rooting, firmware analysis and persistent credentials of TP-Link TL-841N
items.title_zh: TP-Link TL-841N 路由器的 Rooting、固件分析与持久凭证
items.summary_en: This post dissects how to root the TP-Link TL-841N and analyzes its firmware to reveal security weaknesses, including credentials that survive reflash. It highlights how consumer routers can harbor persistent backdoors and why such persistence matters for threat modeling and firmware security practices.
items.summary_zh: 文章详细讲解如何对 TP-Link TL-841N 路由器进行 Rooting，并对固件进行分析，揭示安全漏洞及持续存在的凭证。提示了家用路由器中可能存在的持久后门问题，以及在威胁建模和固件安全实践中的意义。

items.title_en: Karpathy’s Pelican
items.title_zh: Karpathy 的 Pelican
items.summary_en: Karpathy’s Pelican offers a glimpse into a project around the Pelican static site generator associated with Karpathy.
items.summary_zh: Karpathy 的 Pelican 项目简述，揭示他在 Pelican 静态站点生成器上的使用或实验。

items.title_en: US Treasury undertakes historic intervention in yen market
items.title_zh: 美国财政部对日元市场进行历史性干预
items.summary_en: The U.S. Treasury’s intervention in the yen market marks a rare direct action in currency markets, signaling heightened concern about volatility and potential policy coordination with other central banks. The move could influence FX liquidity, risk premia, and global funding dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 美财政部对日元市场的干预是罕见的直接行动，体现对波动的担忧及可能与其他央行的协同。此举可能影响外汇流动性、风险溢价及全球融资格局。

items.title_en: F*: A general-purpose proof-oriented programming language
items.title_zh: F*：通用的、以证明为导向的编程语言
items.summary_en: F* is a general-purpose, proof-oriented programming language with a ML-like syntax and dependent types. It enables writing verifiable software, with abilities to extract code to OCaml or F#, making it relevant for security-critical applications and formal verification efforts.
items.summary_zh: F* 是一种通用、以证明为导向的编程语言，采用 ML 风格语法并支持依赖类型。它可编写可验证的软件，并能提取为 OCaml/F#，在安全关键应用与形式化验证领域具有价值。

items.title_en: Sharing an X11 Server Across Hosts with FamilyWild
items.title_zh: 用 FamilyWild 在多主机间共享 X11 服务器
items.summary_en: Describes a method to share an X11 session across multiple hosts, enabling remote GUI apps with manageable latency. Highlights setup, potential security concerns, and practical use cases for dev machines and remote workflows.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一款工具/方法，使 X11 会话能够跨主机共享，方便在远程环境中运行 GUI 应用。讨论了设置、潜在的安全性问题以及在开发机和远程工作流中的实际用例。

items.title_en: Let the machines in
items.title_zh: 让机器进入
items.summary_en: A perspective on embracing automation and AI agents in workflows, arguing that defensive guardrails should coexist with expanded machine decision-making. It touches on productivity gains and human-machine collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 强调在工作流中让机器介入、使用自动化和AI 代理以提升生产力，同时讨论在安全边界与可控性之间的平衡。凸显人机协作的潜在收益。

items.title_en: How Google helped destroy adoption of RSS feeds (2023)
items.title_zh: 谷歌如何助推RSS订阅的衰落（2023）
items.summary_en: Google’s product and policy choices helped marginalize RSS, accelerating its decline in adoption. Centralized platforms controlled feed discovery and access, leaving RSS ecosystems with limited visibility; for builders, the takeaway is to rely on open standards and independent readers rather than platform-dictated discovery.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾谷歌的一系列产品与策略如何弱化RSS的普及，推动其走向边缘。平台对内容发现的垄断让RSS缺乏可见度，开发者应坚持开放标准与独立阅读器，以避免被平台支配的发现机制所束缚。

items.title_en: Diátaxis
items.title_zh: Diátaxis 框架
items.summary_en: Diátaxis provides four content types to cover different reader needs: tutorials, how-tos, references, and explanations. By aligning information to these categories, teams can craft documentation that supports both learning and practical use, improving overall clarity.
items.summary_zh: Diátaxis 将文档分成教程、使用方法、参考手册和讲解四类，以满足不同读者的需求。按这四种用途组织内容，有助于新手学习、老手快速查阅，并提升整份文档的一致性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Bor – Open-source policy management for Linux desktops
items.title_zh: Bor：Linux 桌面开源策略管理工具
items.summary_en: Bor is an open-source policy management tool for Linux desktops, aimed at standardizing security and user settings across devices. It provides policy templates and a centralized approach to desktop administration for teams.
items.summary_zh: Bor 是一个面向 Linux 桌面端的开源策略管理工具，旨在在多设备之间统一安全与用户设置。它提供策略模板与集中化的桌面管理。

items.title_en: Go 1.27 Interactive Tour
items.title_zh: Go 1.27 互动导览
items.summary_en: Go 1.27 introduces an interactive, in-browser tour that guides new users through core language concepts with runnable examples. It reduces onboarding friction and helps developers practice idioms in context, potentially boosting adoption.
items.summary_zh: Go 1.27 引入在浏览器中的互动导览，通过可运行的示例带新手学习语言要点。降低入门门槛，帮助开发者更快练习语法和模式，提升上手速度。

items.title_en: Show HN: Elevators
items.title_zh: Show HN：Elevators
items.summary_en: Show HN project called Elevators presents a novel approach or tool related to elevator systems—either scheduling, simulation, or a microservice concept—demonstrating practical, small-scale engineering work. It invites community feedback and iteration.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Elevators 项目展示了一个与电梯相关的工具/演示，可能是调度、仿真或小型工程原型，欢迎社区反馈与迭代。

items.title_en: Pushes to arch AUR are suspendended right now.
items.title_zh: 当前 Arch AUR 提交推送暂停
items.summary_en: Pushes to Arch Linux AUR are suspended, halting new package submissions and updates. This pause affects maintainers and users relying on community contributions for software availability.
items.summary_zh: 当前 Arch Linux 的 AUR 提交推送暂停，阻止新包提交和更新。此举将影响维护者和依赖 AUR 的用户，对软件获取产生直接影响。

items.title_en: A fresh look at CPU silent data corruption in modern data centers
items.title_zh: Afresh look at CPU silent data corruption in modern data centers
items.summary_en: A thorough look at the risk of silent data corruption in modern CPUs in data centers, detailing root causes, measurement highlights, and practical mitigations like ECC and architectural mitigations.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究聚焦现代数据中心 CPU 的静默数据损坏风险，剖析成因、度量结果与可行的缓解方法，如 ECC、RAS 等。提供对系统可靠性的实用建议。

items.title_en: Seedance 2.5
items.title_zh: Seedance 2.5
items.summary_en: Seedance 2.5 updates a content creation workflow with flexible referencing and one-take creation. It enables creators to fluidly link assets and references, reducing friction in long-form production.
items.summary_zh: Seedance 2.5 为内容创作工作流带来灵活的引用和一镜到底式的创作能力，使创作者能够更自然地在作品中嵌入可重用的素材与引用，降低制作摩擦。

items.title_en: Show HN: I'm a 15 Year Old Wannabe Engineer, This Is a Cycloidal Gearbox I Built
items.title_zh: Show HN：我是个15岁的准工程师，这就是我做的摆线齿轮箱
items.summary_en: A 15-year-old builds and documents a cycloidal gear gearbox, sharing design choices, fabrication steps, and lessons learned. It demonstrates how ambitious hobbyist projects can accelerate learning and showcase practical engineering skills.
items.summary_zh: 一位15岁的准工程师分享自己设计并制造的摆线齿轮箱，记录了设计、加工与经验教训。展示了热情型的硬件项目如何促进学习并磨炼实际动手能力。

items.title_en: Artificial Intelligence: Ars Notoria and the Promise of Instant Knowledge
items.title_zh: 人工智能：Ars Notoria 与即时知识的承诺
items.summary_en: Ars Notoria is a medieval manuscript about memory and rapid knowledge acquisition, contrasted with modern AI promises of instant expertise. The piece reflects on historical quests for quick learning and cautions against shortcuts to understanding.
items.summary_zh: 《Ars Notoria》是关于记忆与快速获取知识的中世纪手稿，与现代人工智能的即时知识承诺形成对照。本文反思人类对快速学习的历史追求，并警示对理解的捷径风险。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fuse – statically typed functional programming language
items.title_zh: Fuse：静态类型的函数式编程语言
items.summary_en: Fuse is a new statically typed functional programming language focused on simplicity and reliable type systems. It provides a fresh entry point for experimenting with safe, purely functional code and learning functional paradigms.
items.summary_zh: Fuse 是一种新兴的静态类型函数式编程语言，强调简洁性与可靠的类型系统。它为安全、纯函数式代码的探索提供了新的入口。

items.title_en: Harvesting SSH Credentials: Insights from My Honeypot Network
items.title_zh: SSH 凭据收集：来自我的蜜罐网络的洞察
items.summary_en: From a honeypot network, the author shares patterns attackers use to harvest SSH credentials, including brute-force attempts and credential stuffing. The piece offers practical takeaways for defenders on hardening SSH, monitoring unusual login activity, and reducing exposure.
items.summary_zh: 作者基于蜜罐网络的观察，揭示攻击者如何获取 SSH 凭证，包括常见的暴力破解与凭证泄露路径。提供对 SSH 强化、监控异常认证和降低攻击面等的实用建议。

items.title_en: Running Kimi K3 on MI355X at Better Performance per Dollar Than B300
items.title_zh: 在 MI355X 上运行 Kimi K3：性价比高于 B300
items.summary_en: Benchmarking Kimi K3 on the MI355X shows a better performance-per-dollar than the B300, signaling an attractive option for edge AI or compact compute. The setup highlights how hardware choice and optimization can materially shift cost-effectiveness.
items.summary_zh: 在 MI355X 上对 Kimi K3 的基准测试显示其性价比优于 B300，成为边缘AI或小型计算的更具性价比的选项。该结果强调了硬件选择与优化对成本效益的实质性影响。

items.title_en: The Myth of Snow Leopard
items.title_zh: 雪豹神话
items.summary_en: A critical look at the lore around Snow Leopard (OS X 10.6), debunking myths about its performance narrative and exploring what real-world users got vs. hype. The piece prompts more nuanced thinking about OS optimizations.
items.summary_zh: 对雪豹时代（Snow Leopard）传闻的批判性审视，揭示其性能叙述背后的神话与现实差距。文章将焦点放在系统优化与用户体验的真实收益上。

items.title_en: Bubble Memory
items.title_zh: 气泡存储器
items.summary_en: A concise explainer of bubble memory, an early non-volatile memory technology that stores data with magnetic domains. It covers how it works, why it was explored, and why it ultimately ceded ground to RAM and flash.
items.summary_zh: 气泡存储器是一种早期的非易失性记忆技术，依赖磁性磁域存储信息。文章回顾了其工作原理、发展历程以及为何最终让位于 RAM 与闪存。

items.title_en: AI financial advice is surprisingly good, especially if you ask right questions
items.title_zh: AI 金融建议相当靠谱，尤其当你问对问题
items.summary_en: AI-based financial advice can be surprisingly effective when questions are well-posed and data sources are solid. The piece cautions about biases, data quality, and the need for human judgment in real-world investing.
items.summary_zh: AI 驱动的金融建议在问题设计得当且数据质量高时出乎意料地靠谱；但仍需警惕偏见、数据与风险管理，以及在人类判断中的作用。

items.title_en: Rust All Hands 2026 Retrospective
items.title_zh: Rust All Hands 2026 回顾
items.summary_en: Rust All Hands 2026 retrospective highlights roadmap decisions, compiler and library progress, and community health signals. The event underscores the language’s ongoing evolution and the collective effort shaping its future.
items.summary_zh: Rust All Hands 2026 的回顾聚焦路线图、编译器与库的进展，以及社区健康状况，凸显语言的持续演进与共同体对未来的塑造。

items.title_en: TinyNES Review – A Super Niche NES Console
items.title_zh: TinyNES 评测——一款极度小众的 NES 主机
items.summary_en: A review of TinyNES, a micro NES console with an ultra-niche footprint. It covers hardware build, emulation accuracy, game compatibility, and who would enjoy such a focused retro device.
items.summary_zh: 对 TinyNES 的评测聚焦于这款极度小众的 NES 主机的硬件构建、仿真准确性与游戏兼容性。总结它的定位、适合的极客圈子以及为何会成为收藏级产品。

items.title_en: Adding Go's Defer to the TypeScript Compiler
items.title_zh: 把 Go 的 defer 加进 TypeScript 编译器
items.summary_en: Describes a compile-time feature proposal to bring Go's defer semantics into TypeScript, enabling deterministic cleanup blocks without cluttering user code. It highlights potential benefits and the complexity of cross-language semantics.
items.summary_zh: 介绍将 Go 的 defer 语义带入 TypeScript 编译过程的设想，旨在实现更干净的资源清理与确定性执行。并讨论跨语言语义带来的复杂性与潜在收益。

items.title_en: NetBSD 11.0
items.title_zh: NetBSD 11.0 发布
items.summary_en: NetBSD 11.0 ships with updated kernel and userland, broader hardware support, and a refreshed toolchain with security hardening. The release underscores NetBSD's continued focus on portability across diverse platforms and architectures, appealing to developers who deploy on uncommon hardware.
items.summary_zh: NetBSD 11.0 发布，内核和用户空间更新，硬件支持范围扩展，工具链也进行了升级并加强了安全性。此版本再次强调了 NetBSD 在跨平台与小众硬件上的可移植性，对需要稳定方案的开发者具有吸引力。

items.title_en: Cursor removed cost information from the usage page and CSV export
items.title_zh: Cursor 从用量页面和 CSV 导出中移除成本信息
items.summary_en: Cursor removed cost information from the usage page and CSV export, raising pricing-transparency concerns for developers tracking spend. The move invites questions about how users should monitor costs and what future pricing signals will look like.
items.summary_zh: Cursor 从用量页面和 CSV 导出中移除了成本信息，引发开发者对定价透明度的关注。此举让用户更难监控支出，并引发对未来定价信号的猜想。

items.title_en: Show HN: MicroCodex Coding Agent – OpenAI/codex reimplemented in C++ <1MB binary
items.title_zh: Show HN: MicroCodex Coding Agent——用 C++ 重实现 OpenAI Codex，二进制小于 1MB
items.summary_en: A compact reimplementation of a coding agent inspired by Codex, shipped as a sub-1MB C++ binary. It demonstrates how AI-assisted coding can be squeezed into a tiny, portable tool, though likely not on par with full models.

items.title_en: Show HN: Syncular – offline-first SQL sync with TypeScript and Rust cores
items.title_zh: Syncular：离线优先的 SQL 同步，TypeScript 与 Rust 内核
items.summary_en: Syncular offers offline-first SQL synchronization with TypeScript and Rust cores, aiming to deliver robust, locally-first data apps. It highlights hybrid JS/Rust architectures for performance and safety in data-sync workloads.
items.summary_zh: Syncular 提供离线优先的 SQL 同步，核心由 TypeScript 与 Rust 实现，力求在数据同步工作负载中实现性能与安全性的结合，适合本地优先的数据应用。

items.title_en: A Surveillance Treaty in Disguise: Canada Signs UN Cybercrime Convention
items.title_zh: 披着监控外衣的条约：加拿大签署联合国网络犯罪公约
items.summary_en: Canada quietly signed the UN Cybercrime Convention, a move critics say could expand government surveillance and cross-border data cooperation. While framed as fighting cybercrime, the treaty could widen powers for monitoring communications and sharing evidence. For tech developers and privacy advocates, this signals a shift in international norms around digital rights.
items.summary_zh: 加拿大悄然签署联合国网络犯罪公约，批评者认为这可能扩大政府监控和跨境数据协作的权限。条约表述了打击网络犯罪的法律框架，但也被指可能扩张监控能力、加强内容审查。对技术开发者和隐私倡导者而言，这标志着国际网络执法与数字权利规范的潜在转折。

items.title_en: Anime User Interfaces
items.title_zh: 动漫风格的用户界面
items.summary_en: A survey of UI concepts and prototypes inspired by anime aesthetics, exploring how visual language, animation, and storytelling techniques influence interface design. It offers ideas for expressive, playful, and legible interfaces in apps and tools.
items.summary_zh: 对 anime 风格的用户界面进行概览，探讨动画、风格与叙事如何影响交互设计，并提出在应用与工具中可落地的表达性设计思路。

items.title_en: ESP32-C3 SuperMini antenna modification
items.title_zh: ESP32-C3 SuperMini 天线修改
items.summary_en: This guide documents practical antenna modifications for the ESP32-C3 SuperMini module to improve range and signal quality, including measurements and caveats for hobbyists and embedded developers.
items.summary_zh: 本指南记录了对 ESP32-C3 SuperMini 模组天线的实际修改方法，以提升覆盖范围与信号质量，并给出测量数据与注意事项，适合爱好者与嵌入式开发者。

items.title_en: MkLinux and the pimped-out Apple Workgroup Server 9150
items.title_zh: MkLinux 与改装后的 Apple Workgroup Server 9150
items.summary_en: A retrospective on MkLinux running on the Apple Workgroup Server 9150, detailing how enthusiasts repurposed a PPC Mac into a Linux box, including hardware mods and integration quirks. It's a nostalgic look at early cross-platform enthusiasm that foreshadowed modern open ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 MkLinux 在 Apple Workgroup Server 9150 上的实现，讲述爱好者如何把 PPC Mac 改造成 Linux 盒子、遇到的硬件改装与兼容性挑战。展现早期跨平台热情，以及对如今开放生态的先行影响。

items.title_en: The Art of 64-bit Assembly
items.title_zh: 64 位汇编的艺术
items.summary_en: A book-length treatment of 64-bit assembly language, focusing on modern x86-64 instruction sets, conventions, and optimization techniques. It digs into low-level programming practices that underpin compilers, runtimes, and performance-critical software, helping developers reason about machine code. A valuable read for advanced systems programmers and hardware-curious engineers.
items.summary_zh: 一本关于 64 位汇编语言的长篇著作，聚焦现代 x86-64 指令集、约定与优化技巧。内容深入低级编程实践，揭示支撑编译器、运行时与高性能软件的底层原理，帮助开发者理解机器码。对于高级系统程序员与对硬件感兴趣的工程师而言，是值得一读的资料。

items.summary_zh: 此事后分析从根本原因到修复过程梳理了内核健全性漏洞 #14576，阐述其对内存安全的影响及修复方案，强调健壮工具和子系统边界在内核可靠性中的作用。

items.title_en: ASRock BC-250: Building the Budget Steam Machine
items.title_zh: ASRock BC-250：打造预算 Steam 机器

items.title_en: Deep-sea vehicles spot 'alien' sharks deep beneath the waves in the Pacific
items.title_zh: 深海探测器在太平洋深处发现“外星”鲨鱼
items.summary_en: Autonomous deep-sea vehicles captured footage of unusual sharks far below the surface, revealing new biology and behavior at depth. The find underscores the diversity of marine life and the value of undersea robotics for discovery.
items.summary_zh: 深海探测载具在太平洋深处发现形态独特的鲨鱼，揭示深海生物多样性与行为模式的新线索。凸显无人在场下潜和自主潜水器对科学发现的价值。

items.title_en: Unraveling the mysteries of habit formation
items.title_zh: 揭开习惯形成的奥秘
items.summary_en: Reviews habit formation research, outlining cues, routines, rewards, and environment shaping behavior, and translates neuroscience into practical guidance for designers and individuals aiming to form or break habits.
items.summary_zh: 综述习惯形成的最新研究，解析线索、例行程序、奖励与环境如何塑造行为，并给产品设计与个人改造带来可落地的启示。

items.title_en: The Rise of Million-Dollar Companies with Just One Employee
items.title_zh: 仅有一名员工就能成立百万美元级别公司的崛起
items.summary_en: A WSJ piece on the rise of million-dollar companies run by a single person, enabled by automation, SaaS, and scalable business models. It explores how founders leverage platforms, contractors, and AI to generate outsized revenue with minimal headcount, raising questions about valuation and risk.
items.summary_zh: 华尔街日报讨论了单人即可运营、市值达百万级的公司崛起，得益于自动化、SaaS 与可扩展的商业模式。文章分析创始人如何借助平台、外包和 AI，在极小团队规模下实现高额收入，同时也提出对估值、风险及未来创业模式的讨论。

items.title_en: Atom is better than RSS, in ways that matter
items.title_zh: Atom 在关键方面优于 RSS
items.summary_en: Argues that Atom offers practical advantages over RSS, including metadata richness and extensibility that matter to developers and tooling. The piece links feed design to real-world application needs.
items.summary_zh: 论述 Atom 在元数据丰富性、可扩展性等方面对开发者和工具链的实际价值，胜过 RSS 的关键点。与实际应用场景的关系被强调。

items.title_en: RFC 10015: Deprecating Obsolete Key Exchange Methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2
items.title_zh: RFC 10015：在 TLS 1.2/DTLS 1.2 中弃用过时的密钥交换方法

items.summary_zh: RFC 10015 建议在 TLS 1.2/DTLS 1.2 中弃用过时的密钥交换方法，以提升安全性。文中给出服务器和客户端迁移的具体步骤与注意事项。

items.summary_zh: Katharos 将 CSP 风格的并发引入 Python，提供通道等安全原语，帮助构建更安全、结构化的并发应用。对于寻求更稳健并发模型的 Python 开发者具有参考意义。

items.summary_zh: 提出在前K个候选猜测中选取最佳者来引导训练的做法，属于探索性建模。此方法可能提高样本效率与对不确定模型的鲁棒性，适用于多模型并存的情景。

items.summary_zh: 一种受存储技术启发的内存新技术可能将 GPU 显存推向 TB 级别，使更大规模的模型训练在不依赖交换区的情况下成为现实，从而改变 AI 硬件的成本结构与设计思路。

items.title_zh: 128 位处理器的前景（John Mashey，SGI 1995）

items.summary_zh: Kaisel 引入了路由即值的理念，作为 Flutter 的 Dart 3 原生路由器的一部分，提供类型安全、可在编译时校验的导航。该设计旨在提升大型应用的可维护性与性能，减少样板代码和路由错误。

items.summary_zh: 一本关于标点符号美学与用法的趣味手册，展示微小符号如何影响文本与代码的节奏感。

items.title_en: Kobuk the Destroyer – Tales from the Wild, Unseen World of Test Engineering
items.title_zh: Kobuk the Destroyer：野外、未见世界的测试工程故事
items.summary_en: Kobuk the Destroyer gathers tales from the wild world of test engineering, revealing unseen challenges, failures, and the craft of QA and reliability work. A candid look at how tests shape products.
items.summary_zh: 《Kobuk the Destroyer》汇集了测试工程的野外故事，揭示未曾公开的挑战、失败以及质量保证与可靠性工作的技艺。对测试如何塑造产品提供坦诚观察。

items.title_en: Norway Salmon
items.title_zh: 挪威三文鱼：全球巨头的崛起
items.summary_en: An analysis of how Norway's salmon industry evolved into a global behemoth, driven by scalable farming, favorable regulations, and strong export networks. It discusses supply chain dynamics, technology adoption in aquaculture, and sustainability debates.
items.summary_zh: 解读挪威三文鱼产业如何通过可扩张的养殖模式、有利的监管环境和强大的出口网络，发展成全球巨头。文章还探讨了养殖业中的供应链、技术应用及相关的可持续性议题。

items.title_en: Linux on ESP32
items.title_zh: 在 ESP32 上运行 Linux
items.summary_en: A bold experiment ports a Linux kernel to the ESP32-S31 microcontroller, showing the limits of running a full OS on ultra-low-power hardware. The effort highlights the engineering hurdles—memory constraints, boot, drivers—and what it means for edge computing experiments and hobbyist hardware hacking. Not production-ready, but a milestone in expanding where Linux can run.
items.summary_zh: 在极低功耗硬件上尝试将 Linux 内核移植到 ESP32-S31，展示了完整操作系统在此类设备上的边界与挑战。该工作揭示了记忆体约束、启动与驱动等工程难题，以及这对边缘计算实验和爱好者硬件 Black 盒的意义。虽然尚未达到生产就绪，但标志着 Linux 可运行范围的扩展。

items.title_en: Developers are attached to tools because tools encode trust
items.title_zh: 开发者依赖工具，因为工具编码信任
items.summary_en: Developers grow attached to tools because those tools encode trust—promises about behavior, reliability, and security. Once trust is established, teams keep using the same tools even as new options emerge, shaping workflows and ecosystem choices. The piece reflects on how tooling design subtly steers engineering decisions.
items.summary_zh: 开发者之所以依赖工具，是因为工具把信任编码进去——对行为、可靠性与安全性的承诺。一旦建立信任，团队就会继续使用相同的工具，即使出现新的替代方案，也会被工作流和生态系统取向所左右。文章反映了工具设计如何在潜移默化中引导工程决策。

items.title_en: Fasttracker II clone in C using SDL 2
items.title_zh: 用 SDL2 的 C 实现的 Fasttracker II 克隆
items.summary_en: This is a C-based clone of the classic Fasttracker II using SDL2, illustrating how retro audio software can be recreated with modern toolchains. It serves as a case study in faithful reproduction and performance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个用 SDL2 实现的经典 Fasttracker II 的克隆，展示了如何用现代工具链重现怀旧音频软件，并带来实现风格与性能的权衡。

items.title_en: Elena, a library for building Progressive Web Components
items.title_zh: Elena：用于构建渐进式网页组件的库
items.summary_en: Elena is a library designed for building Progressive Web Components, offering a concise API for composing custom elements with templating and reactive state. It aims to streamline component-based web apps without heavy boilerplate.
items.summary_zh: Elena 提供简洁 API 的库，用于构建渐进式网页组件，支持模板化和响应式状态管理，目标是用更少的样板代码实现组件化的网页应用。

items.title_en: We accidentally built an LLVM compiler for Jax
items.title_zh: 我们意外地为 Jax 构建了一个 LLVM 编译器
items.summary_en: A project story explains how an LLVM-based compiler for JAX emerged unintentionally, detailing surprising design choices and potential performance implications. It serves as a cautionary tale about scope creep in research tooling.
items.summary_zh: 讲述一个意外产生的 JAX 与 LLVM 相关工具链，分析设计选择与潜在的性能影响，成为研究工具范围意外扩展的警示案例。

items.title_en: Glyphs 4 – the leading Mac font editor
items.title_zh: Glyphs 4：Mac 字体编辑器的领导者
items.summary_en: Glyphs 4 ships with a refreshed UI, faster workflows, and improved variable font support, reinforcing its position as the go-to Mac font editor for professional type designers.
items.summary_zh: Glyphs 4 发布，界面焕新、工作流更快，并增强了对可变字体的支持，进一步巩固其作为专业字体设计工具的地位。

items.title_en: Note-Taking and Personal Knowledge Management
items.title_zh: 笔记与个人知识管理
items.summary_en: Note-taking is more than just collecting words; it's about personal knowledge management. The piece outlines practical methods for organizing notes, linking ideas, and designing retrieval-friendly systems to boost learning and creativity.
items.summary_zh: 好的笔记不仅是记录信息，更是管理知识的体系。本文提供将笔记分解为可复用的原子笔记、建立双向链接与定期回顾的做法，帮助提高检索与创新效率。

items.title_en: Nyctography: A substituton cypher by Lewis Carroll
items.title_zh: Nyctography：刘易斯·卡罗尔的夜间替代密码
items.summary_en: Nyctography is Lewis Carroll’s night-writing cipher, a playful substitution system designed for secret notes by lamplight. The piece explains how the system worked and its place in Carroll’s linguistic experiments.
items.summary_zh: Nyctography 是刘易斯·卡罗尔在夜间写秘密笔记时使用的替代密码，体现了其语言游戏中的趣味与实验。文中介绍了其工作原理及在卡罗尔创作中的地位。

items.title_en: The Burau representation of the braid group is faithful for n = 4
items.title_zh: braid 群的 Burau 表示在 n=4 时是保真的
items.summary_en: A math paper proves the Burau representation of braid groups is faithful for n=4, resolving a long-standing case and impacting knot theory and linear representations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文证明在 n=4 时， braid 群的 Burau 表示是保真的，解决了长期未定的一支分支问题，并对结理论与线性表示产生重要影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Logan Basic v2.1 - An online BASIC interpreter.
items.title_zh: Show HN：Logan Basic v2.1——一个在线 BASIC 解释器
items.summary_en: Logan Basic v2.1 is an online BASIC interpreter that runs in the browser, lowering the barrier to learning and experimenting with BASIC without local setup. It’s a neat demo of browser-based language execution.
items.summary_zh: Logan Basic v2.1 是一个在浏览器中运行的在线 BASIC 解释器，降低学习与试验 BASIC 的门槛，无需本地环境。是浏览器端语言执行的有趣演示。

items.title_en: Read the Novels and Forget Everything Else
items.title_zh: 读小说，忘却其他一切
items.summary_en: An argument for immersive fiction as a mental exercise and cultural medium, pushing back against data-driven reading habits. It emphasizes deep reading, attention, and the value of novels in shaping perception.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张沉浸式小说对心智训练与文化理解的重要性，反思以数据驱动的阅读习惯。强调深度阅读、注意力集中及小说在塑造认知与视角方面的价值。

items.title_en: Turtle-inspired interactive Python project
items.title_zh: 灵感来自乌龟的交互式 Python 项目
items.summary_en: A turtle-inspired interactive Python project demonstrates turtle graphics for playful visuals and educational programming. It showcases how simple APIs can create engaging, interactive experiences.
items.summary_zh: 一个受乌龟绘图启发的交互式 Python 项目，展示了富有趣味性的可视化效果与教学潜力。通过简单的绘图 API，适合初学者上手。

items.title_en: Schmitt Trigger: Robust Comparator Design with Hysteresis
items.title_zh: 施密特触发器：带滞环的鲁棒比较器设计
items.summary_en: A technical piece on making comparators more robust using Schmitt trigger hysteresis to suppress noise and chatter. It discusses design tradeoffs and practical circuit considerations for reliable sensing.
items.summary_zh: 通过引入滞环，施密特触发器提高了比较放大器对噪声的鲁棒性，减少振铃与误触发。文中讨论了设计权衡和现场应用的要点。

items.title_en: P[drive failure]: how reliable is your NAS?
items.title_zh: P[驱动失败]：你的 NAS 有多可靠？
items.summary_en: This piece dives into drive failure rates in NAS setups, evaluating RAID resilience, drive wear, and reliability metrics. It offers practical guidance on backups, redundancy, monitoring, and failure recovery.
items.summary_zh: 文章评估 NAS 设备的驱动器故障率、RAID 坚韧性与可靠性指标，给出备份、冗余、监控和故障恢复的实用建议。

items.title_en: The Theater of Sport: Bill Buford Revisits Among the Thugs
items.title_zh: 体育剧场：比勒·布福特重访“Among the Thugs”
items.summary_en: Bill Buford revisits the world of sports fandom and hooliganism, offering literary reportage on the culture of extremity and its implications for society and sport. A thoughtful dive into how language and power shape fandom.
items.summary_zh: 比尔·布福德重访体育狂热与斗殴文化，提供对极端化文化及其对社会与体育的影响的文学式报道。深入探讨语言与权力如何塑造球迷文化。
